title: Speaking — Packing for trips
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on packing for trips.

questions: What do you like about the room you use most?
Is there a part of your home you rarely use?
How long have you lived in your current home?
What would you put in a room of your own?
Do you usually pack well in advance?
What is one thing you often take on a short journey?

part2.topic: Describe a trip on which something you brought proved useful.
part2.closing: and explain what it taught you about preparing for trips.

questions: How have restrictions on luggage changed how people travel?
To what extent should travel companies give customers advice about what to bring?
How has everyday life connected with packing for trips changed for people of different ages?
